questions.question: What distinguishes an altcoin from Bitcoin?

options.A: Altcoins sind immer Stablecoins, die an den Dollar gebunden sind.
options.B: Altcoins sind alternative Kryptowährungen, die andere Technologien oder Anwendungszwecke nutzen.
options.C: Altcoins sind immer die neuesten Versionen von Bitcoin.
options.D: Altcoins können nur an dezentralen Börsen gehandelt werden.

Which hero of Greek mythology is known for his twelve labors?

Heracles, also known as Hercules in Roman mythology, had to perform twelve nearly impossible tasks that were imposed on him. These deeds are central elements of Greek mythology and demonstrate his immense strength and bravery.
